description: THE tool for "what changed / what's new with X in the last N weeks" and for timelines of a competitor's moves — prefer it over get_battlecard, list_competitor_moves, list_signals or ask_industrylens for those questions. Returns the dated CHANGE-FEED for one competitor: every real was→now strategic shift IndustryLens detected, newest-first, each stamped with its real analysis date (never a fabricated date) — optionally since a given date. Input a domain or name. On an authenticated account, a competitor in your OWN tracked set always answers from your account change feed (`source: "account"`, never the public 'not covered' upsell), even if it's outside the small public showcase set. Returns { covered: false } with a CTA for companies not publicly tracked. Pass `companies` (up to 10 names/domains) instead of domain/name to get a change feed for several competitors in one call — each gets its own result block, in the order given. On an authenticated account, pass `group` (a strategic group name or id — see get_my_market's strategic_groups) instead of domain/name/companies to get a change feed for every member of that group in one call.

companies.description: Batch alternative to domain/name: up to 10 company names or domains. Omit domain/name when using this. Returns one change feed per entry, in input order; `since`/`limit` apply to every entry.

domain.description: Company domain or homepage URL (e.g. 'apollo.io'). Preferred — most precise.

group.description: Account-tier only: a strategic group name or id. Alternative to domain/name/companies — returns a change feed for every member of that group, in one call, labelled with the group name.

mode.description: 'summary' (default): top lines per company, says how many were left out. 'full': every field, today's shape — no mode/shown/omitted/note keys. Applies to both your own tracked competitors and the public showcase set.

name.description: Company name (e.g. 'Apollo'). Used when no domain is given.

since.description: Optional ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Only moves analyzed on/after this date are returned.

name: get_competitor_moves_diff
title: Get a competitor's dated change feed
